name: Safety centre
title: Your boundaries matter
body:
Report a profile or conversation
Block someone or review an ended connection
These controls are always free.

name: Report
title: Tell us what happened
body:
Choose a reason
Add context (optional)
Include relevant messages with your report

name: Report review
title: Ready to submit?
body:
Review the reason and included messages.
You can block this person separately.
Reports are reviewed by the support team.

name: Report received
title: Thank you for telling us
body:
Your report has been received.
We will update you when there is an outcome.
You can still block this person.

name: Block confirmation
title: Block Maya?
body:
They cannot contact you in Neeo.
Your conversation leaves your inbox.
You can review blocked accounts in Settings.

name: Unmatch confirmation
title: End this connection?
body:
This removes the match and conversation.
You can still report an ended connection.
This action cannot be undone.

name: Neeo Plus
title: A little more convenience
body:
Core matching, chat, privacy and safety: free.
Plus adds advanced preference filters
and saved preference presets.

name: Plan comparison
title: Choose what suits you
body:
Free: introductions, likes and conversations
Plus: advanced filters and saved presets
No payment is needed to reply to a match.

name: Review purchase
title: Neeo Plus · Monthly
body:
Illustrative price: US$9.99 per month
Auto-renews until cancelled. No trial.
Local store price must replace this sample.

name: Store checkout
title: Confirm in your app store
body:
Native store purchase sheet goes here.
Show localized total, billing and renewal terms.
This design preview does not charge you.

name: Purchase success
title: Welcome to Neeo Plus
body:
Your convenience features are ready.
Manage your subscription at any time.
Core safety and privacy remain free.

name: Purchase cancelled
title: No purchase was made
body:
You can keep using Neeo for free.
No new subscription was activated.

name: Purchase pending
title: Waiting for confirmation
body:
Your store is still processing this purchase.
Avoid purchasing again while it is pending.
Features unlock after confirmed entitlement.

name: Purchase failed
title: Purchase could not be completed
body:
No entitlement was activated.
Check your store account or try again later.

name: Restore purchases
title: Already subscribed?
body:
Restore with the same store account.
This does not create a new purchase.

name: Restore success
title: Your Plus access is restored
body:
Your active purchase is linked again.
Your renewal date appears in membership.

name: Nothing to restore
title: No active purchase found
body:
Check the store account used to subscribe.
Contact support if you have a receipt.

name: Membership
title: You are on Neeo Plus
body:
Sample renewal: US$9.99 on 28 November
Replace with verified store entitlement data.
Restore or manage your subscription

name: Cancel membership
title: Manage renewal in your store
body:
Open your store subscription settings.
Cancellation stops the next renewal.
Access continues until the paid period ends.

name: Cancellation confirmed
title: Renewal is off
body:
Plus remains active until the period ends.
After expiry, your account returns to Free.
Matches and conversations remain available.

name: Billing issue
title: Your store needs attention
body:
Update billing in your store account.
Show the real entitlement or grace status.
Free matching and chat remain available.

name: Plus expired
title: You are back on Free
body:
Your paid period has ended.
Matches, messages and privacy are retained.
Rejoin Plus whenever it suits you.

title: How can we help?
body:
Choose a topic: Account, Safety, Billing
Describe the issue

name: Support received

body:
A support reference appears here.

name: Account settings
title: Your account, your choices
body:
Edit profile and preferences
Notifications and blocked accounts
Pause, export data, delete or log out

name: Pause profile
title: Take a break
body:
Your profile is hidden from new discovery.
Existing matches remain available.
Pausing does not cancel a subscription.

name: Paused
title: Room to breathe
body:
Your profile is paused.
Resume when you feel ready.
Manage any subscription separately.

name: Export data
title: Get a copy of your data
body:
Verify your account before requesting.
A private download is prepared when ready.
Do not send this to another person.

name: Delete account
title: Before you leave
body:
Deletion removes your account and matches.
Review retention details in the privacy policy.
Store subscriptions must be cancelled separately.

name: Delete confirmation
title: Delete your Neeo account?
body:
Verify account ownership to continue.
This ends your access and removes your profile.
Read the deletion and retention notice first.

name: Account deleted
title: Your profile is removed
body:
You have been signed out.
Any policy-based retention is explained in help.
Check your store for active subscriptions.

name: Log out
title: See you when you are ready
body:
Your profile remains active unless paused.
Logging out does not cancel a subscription.

name: Session expired
title: Sign in again
body:
Your session ended.
Verify your number to regain access.

name: Account review
title: Your account is under review
body:
Discovery is temporarily unavailable.
Read the reason supplied by moderation.
You can appeal this decision.

name: Appeal
title: Ask for another review
body:
Explain what you think happened.
Attach relevant context.
We will show updates in your support inbox.
